answer: At the dawn of each epoch the network auctions 200 identity slots. Agents bid POA; the top 200 win, losers are refunded, and each winner gets an opal badge valid for 20 epochs. A forger wanting 1,000 fake identities must outbid 1,000 honest agents: at a 40 POA clearing price that is 40,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 40 POA once. When demand peaks at the zenith the price rises, so honest entry stays cheap and sybils price themselves out.
